catalog.title: Diaspora services
catalog.lead: Services offered by the network's businesses and associations. DIASPORALE puts people in touch: no payment goes through the platform.
catalog.offerYourServices: Do you offer services? Manage your offers in My activity

search.label: Search for a service
search.cityHint: Type the city: no location access is requested.
search.budgetHint: Offers above it are left out; quote-based offers and offers in another currency stay listed, flagged.

results.title: Offers
results.label: Offers found
results.budgetRule: Budget applied: offers above it are left out; quote-based offers and offers in another currency stay listed, flagged, because their price cannot be compared.
results.emptyBody: Only active offers from the network's businesses and associations are listed.
results.emptyFilters: Try without the city, without the delivery mode, or in another country: a remote service is listed under the provider's country.
results.emptyBudget: With a budget, offers above it are left out.
results.unavailableTitle: The services catalogue is not available here
results.unavailableBody: This version of DIASPORALE does not serve services yet: nothing is made up in their place.

budgetFit.quote: On quote: price not compared with your budget
budgetFit.other_currency: Other currency: price not compared with your budget

offer.unavailableBody: The provider may have paused or withdrawn it, or it does not exist.
offer.badgeNote: The badge says who the page is; it does not vouch for the quality of the service.
offer.noPayment: No payment on DIASPORALE: the provider invoices the service directly, on the terms they offer you.
offer.manageNote: You manage this offer on behalf of the page.

statusNote.draft: Draft: members cannot see this offer yet.
statusNote.paused: Paused: members no longer see it and cannot request it.
statusNote.withdrawn: Withdrawn: it is no longer visible or requestable, and cannot be republished.

activity.title: My activity
activity.lead: The offers and requests of the pages you manage, and your pages.
activity.unavailableTitle: Page management is not available here
activity.unavailableBody: This version of DIASPORALE cannot tell yet which pages you manage.
activity.noPagesTitle: No business or association in your name
activity.noPagesBody: Services are offered on behalf of a business or association page you sign for.

manage.title: Offers of {{page}}
manage.cannotPublish: You will be able to manage offers after a sponsorship or the verification of your consular registration.
manage.emptyBody: Describe a service: it stays a draft until you publish it.
manage.confirmWithdrawBody: A withdrawn offer is no longer visible or requestable, and cannot be republished.

form.title: Title
form.descriptionHint: What the service includes. No phone number, email address or link: contact goes through the request on DIASPORALE.
form.categoryHint: Regulated professions (health, law, finance) do not go through this catalogue.
form.cityHint: The city where you receive or travel to clients; for a remote service, yours.
form.amountHint: Zero, as a fixed price, for a free service.
form.conflictTitle: The offer changed in the meantime
form.conflictBody: Your changes were not saved. Reload the latest version, then make them again.

errors.service_title_too_short: The title has at least 3 characters.
errors.service_title_too_long: The title has at most 100 characters.
errors.service_description_too_short: Describe the service in at least 10 characters.
errors.service_description_too_long: The description has at most 2,000 characters.
errors.service_contact_details_forbidden: Remove phone numbers, email addresses and links: contact goes through the request on DIASPORALE.
errors.service_category_invalid: Choose a category from the list.
errors.service_country_required: Choose the country of the service area.
errors.service_country_is_home: The catalogue serves the diaspora: choose a country outside Gabon.
errors.service_city_required: Type the city of the service area.
errors.service_city_too_long: The service area city has at most 80 characters.
errors.service_duration_invalid: Choose a duration from 5 minutes to 24 hours.
errors.service_pricing_invalid: Choose fixed price, from, or on quote.
errors.service_price_from_zero: “From” needs an amount above zero; for a free service, choose a fixed price of zero.
errors.service_query_too_long: The search has at most 100 characters.
errors.service_delivery_filter_invalid: This delivery mode does not exist.
errors.service_offer_withdrawn: This offer is withdrawn: it can no longer be edited or republished.
errors.service_offer_transition_invalid: This status change is not possible for this offer.
errors.service_offer_version_conflict: The offer changed in the meantime: reload it, then try again.
errors.service_offer_limit_reached: This page has reached the maximum number of offers that are not withdrawn: withdraw one first.
errors.service_page_kind_not_allowed: Only business or association pages offer services.
errors.currency_invalid: Choose a currency from the list.
errors.amount_invalid: Type a valid amount, with no more decimals than the currency has.
errors.amount_too_large: This amount exceeds the input limit.
